channel.title: AI News
channel.description: AI News — synthesized feed by ai-news-spider

item.title: NTT turns to AI to fight AI cyberattacks after blocking seven times more attacks
item.description: NTT blocked seven times more cyberattacks in October than a year earlier. CEO Akira Shimada explains how the group is using AI to find flaws first.

item.title: Elastic launches AlertZero AI workers for SoC teams
item.description: Elastic has released a preview of AlertZero, a set of AI Workers for investigating security alerts and proposing responses with supporting evidence.

item.title: Cycode expands UK teams as it seeks to turn AI into a security advantage
item.description: Cycode has established dedicated UK teams as it seeks to bolster AI development security and vulnerability remediation.

item.title: What PHP2Shell reveals about AI
item.description: PHP2Shell, two critical vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) in PHP’s core runtime patched in October, is a case in point.

item.title: Siemens robot foundation models unpack component reels
item.description: Siemens is developing robots that unpack factory deliveries and AI agents that schedule production, with digital twins checking schedules before release.

item.title: US banks tighten AI agent security amid cybersecurity concerns
item.description: US banks are tightening AI agent security through access controls, transaction authorisation, threat detection, and cybersecurity response.

item.title: AI assistants as a traffic source for online stores: what the first data shows
item.description: The first data suggests it can be both, and the difference often comes down to what an assistant can find on your product pages.

item.title: Fulcra launches agent skill to build apps people and agents can use together
item.description: Builders describe what they want to their AI agent, then build and deploy an app with authentication, hosting, and Fulcra’s user-owned context backend.

item.title: How AI music video generators are transforming music video production
item.description: The practical question for musicians is how much of the work happens inside one platform – and how much editing they must still do themselves.

item.title: KPSOL highlight the importance of proper knowledge management for AI models
item.description: KPSOL have recently stressed the importance of proper knowledge management to ensure that AI models are delivering accurate, relevant, and reliable results.

item.title: What it takes to monitor live systems with Gen AI
item.description: Instead of just relying on management personnel watching dashboards, organizations can use generative AI (Gen AI) to revolutionize real-time monitoring.
